title: revocation.check() called before sig verification in validate_chain
description: cert.rs:45-48: revocation.check() is called after build_chain (DN matching only), before pkix_chain::verify_chain_default (signature verification). A CMS bag with a crafted intermediate — correct DN, forged signature — passes build_chain, triggers revocation.check() on the unverified cert, then gets rejected by pkix. If the revocation checker does OCSP/CRL fetching driven by extensions in the crafted cert, this is an SSRF/info-leak vector. Fix: move revocation loop to after the pkix call succeeds.
